title: Random Quadratic Form on a Sphere: Synchronization by Common Noise
abstract: arXiv:2603.06187v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce the Random Quadratic Form (RQF): a stochastic differential equation which formally corresponds to the gradient flow of a random quadratic functional on a sphere. While the one-point dynamics of the system is a Brownian motion and thus has no preferred direction, the two-point motion exhibits nontrivial synchronizing behaviour. In this work we study synchronization of the RQF, namely we give both distributional and path-wise characterizations of the solutions by studying invariant measures and random attractors of the system.   The RQF model is motivated by the study of the role of linear layers in transformers and illustrates the synchronization by common noise phenomena arising in the simplified models of transformers. translated_title: 球面上的随机二次型：公共噪声导致的同步现象
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.06187v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：我们引入了随机二次型（RQF）：一个随机微分方程，形式上对应于球面上随机二次泛函的梯度流。虽然系统的一点动力学是一个布朗运动，因此没有优先方向，但两点运动表现出非平凡的同步行为。在本工作中，我们研究了RQF的同步现象，即通过研究系统的不变测度和随机吸引子，给出了解的分布性和路径性表征。RQF模型受到变压器中线性层作用研究的启发，并说明了在简化变压器模型中出现的公共噪声同步现象。特别地，我们提供了一个（独立于自注意力的）替代解释，用于深度变压器中的聚类行为，并表明即使在缺乏自注意力的情况下，令牌也会聚类。
tldr: 本文提出随机二次型模型，证明其在公共噪声下即使无自注意力也能使变压器中的令牌产生聚类同步现象，提供了对深度变压器聚类行为的新解释。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Random Quadratic Form model and demonstrates that it induces token clustering synchronization under common noise even without self-attention, offering a new explanation for clustering behavior in deep transformers.
